def reverse_number(n):
    if n == 0:
        return 0
    is_negative = n < 0
    n = abs(n)
    reversed_num = 0
    while n > 0:
        reversed_num = reversed_num * 10 + n % 10
        n //= 10
    return -reversed_num if is_negative else reversed_num

n = int(input().strip())
print(reverse_number(n))
